hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_i = O_i[F]; specifically G0001 = F(x,y), G0002 = lim_{y->x} F(x,y), G0003 = d/dx F(x,y), where F(x,y) = (f(x)-f(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: F(x,y) is differentiable with respect to x
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions form a divided-difference family: G0001 is the first divided difference, G0002 is the confluent limit when the second node approaches x, and G0003 is the x-derivative of the first divided difference, which is the confluent second divided difference with a repeated x node.
